title: Concatenated Words
description: Find all words in a given list that are formed by concatenating at least two shorter words from the same list.
pseudocode:
1. Set = new Set(words)
2. results = []
3. function canForm(word, set):
4.   for i = 1 to word.length:
5.     prefix = word.substring(0, i)
6.     suffix = word.substring(i)
7.     if set.has(prefix) and (set.has(suffix) or canForm(suffix, set)):
8.       return true
9.   return false
10. for word in words:
11.   if canForm(word, set): results.push(word)

steps.note: Initialize dictionary set for O(1) lookups: {'cat', 'dog', 'catdog'}
Attempt to split 'cat', no combination of 2+ words found
Both 'cat' and 'dog' exist in set. 'catdog' is a concatenated word.
